title: OpenAI publishes first benchmark results for its Broadcom-built Jalapeño chip
reason: Published. Surfaced via this cycle's triage of fresh ingest (Techmeme, TechCrunch, The Decoder, The Verge all covering OpenAI's 25 Aug benchmark disclosure the same day). dedup-check before opening returned zero matches -- standalone, no prior coverage of Jalapeño existed in the archive despite the chip having first been unveiled 24 June 2026. Full multi-agent protocol run: fresh verifier then fresh adversarial falsifier, both independent (parallel-staged, per policy/verification.md §5). Announcement claims (chip exists, built with Broadcom, inference-only, ~9-month design-to-tape-out) confirmed via two independent Tier-0 primaries (OpenAI's own posts, cross-checked directly against this project's own RSS ingest, and Broadcom's own investor-relations release). The headline benchmark numbers (1.5-1.9x perf/watt, 1.7-3.6x lower latency vs Nvidia Blackwell/GB200/GB300) are OpenAI's own figures -- published as vendor-claim, not confirmed, since SemiAnalysis (which observed the runs) explicitly says it did not independently execute the full benchmark suite. Falsifier caught and corrected a real press overstatement: The Decoder's headline claims Jalapeño 'beats Nvidia's Blackwell and Rubin,' but OpenAI's disclosed benchmarks are Blackwell-only -- Rubin was not available for testing. Deliberately did not cite The Decoder as a source for that reason, and added an explicit confirmed claim stating Rubin was not tested, to inoculate against that misconception. Editor gate (policy/style.md) run on both EN and TR; headline rests only on the confirmed announcement/publication fact, not on the vendor's comparative numbers.
watch: Any independent benchmark of Jalapeño from a third-party evaluator (METR, Vals AI, Artificial Analysis) not fed or supervised by OpenAI
Any Nvidia response or rebuttal to the benchmark comparison (none found as of publication)
A future OpenAI/SemiAnalysis-style disclosure that actually tests Jalapeño against Nvidia's Rubin chips once Rubin ships
